name: SKAVEN: STORMFIENDS
description: Stormfiends are one of the many horrors created by the long, if fraught, alliance between Clans Moulder and Clans Skryre. In appearance, they resemble a Rat Ogor granted even greater bulk through potent warpstone serums, and they can wield various deadly Skryre firearms without tearing themselves apart through recoil.</br></br>This multipart plastic kit builds three Stormfiends, monstrous heavy infantry for your Skaven armies in games of Warhammer Age of Sigmar. Armed with an array of experimental weaponry, they can threaten all targets, and their warpstone-mutated flesh makes them incredibly hard to kill. One Stormfiend can be armed with either Doomflayer Gauntlets or Shock Gauntlets, another with Warpfire Projectors or Windlaunchers, and the final one with either Ratling Cannons or Grinderfists, offering you an impressive arsenal.</br></br>This kit comprises 101 plastic components, and 3x Citadel 60mm Round Bases. These miniatures require assembly and are supplied unpainted – we recommend using Citadel Plastic Glue and Citadel Colour paints.
